issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) misuses pathe.resolve semantics for URL-style sources
issues.detail: The source map spec resolves sources relative to the map's location (dirname). Using resolve(from, '..', s) works for filesystem paths but silently breaks if `from` is a URL or if `s` is absolute/URL-shaped. A clearer data shape is path.resolve(path.dirname(from), s) — names the intent and avoids the '..' trick that obscures what's actually happening.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside hot stack-trace path on every external frame
issues.detail: getSourceMap fires per file during error formatting and does readFileSync + a second readFileSync inside convert-source-map's mapFile path. No cache. For a stack with many external frames this re-reads and re-parses the same files repeatedly. A small Map<file, SourceMap|null> keyed by file is the obvious data structure — the algorithm follows.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile silently returns '{}' for missing map files, masking failures
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' when the referenced map file is absent. That's a stateless filter pretending success. It will produce a valid-but-empty SourceMap and downstream code can't tell the difference between 'no map' and 'map pointed at nothing'. Return undefined or throw, and let the caller decide.

issues.description: Helpers belong in packages/utils/src/source-map, not test-run.ts
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile is a stateless transform: (code, filePath) -> SourceMap | undefined. It has nothing to do with test-run orchestration. Move it next to DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts where the rest of the source-map plumbing lives. Composition over collocation-by-accident.

issues.description: New runtime dep convert-source-map duplicates capability already in the tree
issues.detail: The repo already depends on @jridgewell/trace-mapping and ships its own DecodedMap. Adding convert-source-map (+ @types) for what amounts to 'find a sourceMappingURL comment and read the referenced file' is ~30 lines of regex + fs. Measure the win before taking the dep; a small filter would do.

issues.description: Comment-only branch inside getSourceMap conflates two conditions
issues.detail: `if (!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file))` mixes 'this is external' with 'file exists on disk'. Pull the predicate out: isExternalModule(file) and fileExists(file). Reads better, tests easier, and the next person doesn't have to re-derive the intent from the comment block.

review.summary: The fix is small and targeted, which is the right shape. Two real concerns: the resolve(from, '..', s) change in DecodedMap is correct-ish but obscures intent — path.dirname(from) names what's happening. And the new getSourceMap path does synchronous disk reads per stack frame with no cache, which will hurt on large external stacks. The convert-source-map dependency is doing a job a small filter could do in-tree, and the helper functions belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts next to DecodedMap rather than in test-run.ts. Decision: TOO-MUCH-FRAMEWORK on the new dep; otherwise SMALL-AND-COMPOSABLE with the caching and placement fixes.
